profile.headline: Applying industry-proven solutions to complex problems when possible, and innovating with novel approaches when necessary

positions.title: Engineer/Scientist VI (100% IRAD)
positions.description:
Independent Research and Development (IRAD): 
- Led multi-company team in conducting quantum computing studies to support proprietary research and feasibility studies.
- Utilized closed-form optimization to find near-optimal or provably optimal solutions to problems in the domain of weapon-target assignment, radar scheduling, and distributed satellite tracking.
- Created and deployed AI and quantum applications on AWS using a service-oriented microservice architecture, leveraging Containers, Kubernetes, in a hybrid cloud environment.
- Supported engineers by developing ontologies and creating a Neo4J graph database to facilitate AI work.
- Implemented a simple network simulation in C++ to support a distributed simulation engine.

positions.title: Engineer/Scientist VI (MDA Contract)
positions.description:
- Conducted a feasibility study on private permissioned blockchains for SATCOM
- Worked on the RF simulation team to do root cause analysis with Ansys STK and troubleshot physics issues in Exata simulations

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
MDA and SMDC contracts:
Created C# and C++ applications that communicate with RF telemetry hardware
Built IRIG 106 CH10 Encoder/Decoders/Simulators
Created embedded serial communication applications
Wrote real-time telemetry decommutation software using NetAcquire and Acroamatics
Full-stack development in Angular, .NET, and SQL (when time allowed)

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
OPDASH development for AMCOM Express and MDA at SED (S3I).
The main things I do here: 
C# Web API/MVC,
Angular 5 frontend using ng-Bootstrap 4 for the look and feel,
SQL Server backend,
C# decoders for Link16 on the NSITE project

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Full stack developer developing web applications for MSIC. Frontend powered by AngularJS with a backend driven by MS SQL Server. Primary developer for the database side of the application.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Wrote back end code for web pages for the department of education’s data access and exchange system.
Designed and wrote an algorithm for recursively running stored procedures in their optimal sequence.
Upgraded a shared service scheduler that ran tasks for our applications from a single threaded application to a multithreaded application that allowed multiple applications to run automated processes simultaneously (this software design allowed advanced error handling and detailed error logging that a simple windows schedule would not have allowed).
Wrote Unit Tests for using the NUNIT framework.  Utilized unit tests frameworks for quick debugging and library entry points.
Worked with the Entity Framework (EF) Object Relational Mapper to integrate Database schemas with C# projects.
Assisted in design of a Data Warehouse where de-normalization of data allowed users to run reports on huge sets of data almost instantly (report generation time went from hours to seconds over 200,000% increase in speed)
Worked in an agile shop doing daily scrums in a team oriented environment along with biweekly sprint planning sessions

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed apps for Android Using JAVA, XML, and SQLite for commercial applications.
Developed an Android application that interfaces a USB hardware device using the Android NDK making calls to an API written in C.
Developed automation applications using Visual Basic .Net.
Designed and implemented a localization algorithm in C++ for radios.
Kept precise documentation (Design Document, Test Plan, and Code Comments) and used Git Version Control on a daily basis.
Configured a multi-developer SharePoint development environment.
Configured servers, firewalls, and domain controllers. Completed common IT hardware/software work including managing a Microsoft SharePoint site.
Configured and managed Hypervisors (VMware) for remote server access running Linux & Windows.

positions.title: Production Quality Assurance Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Assisted in automation of delivery order tracking.
Tracked all hardware deliveries to ensure that contracts were completed as described.

educations.schoolName: The University of Alabama in Huntsville
